thread:
Acme_SRE: Hi, we're seeing p99 jump from ~200ms -> ~3s on /v1/chat starting ~03:40 UTC. It looks like requests are egressing to us-east-1 from our Frankfurt clients. Any ideas?
Maya_support: sorry about that — can you share a curl and any response headers you see?
Acme_SRE: quick curl shows `x-redwood-region: us-east1` and `x-request-id: r-9f3b` in response headers.
Maya_support: thanks. tagging SRE: @tom_sre — can you pull traces for r-9f3b and check routing decisions?
tom_sre: got it, pulling trace r-9f3b... main span: edge-proxy (eu-west-1) -> route-decider -> regional-egress-us-east1 -> model-pool-us-east1. Total wall: 2.9s.
tom_sre: decision log shows route chosen at 03:39:12 due to `score_delta` where eu clusters had negative health penalty.
rachel_network: checking LB/health probe logs for eu-west-1 around 03:38-03:40 — I'm seeing intermittent TCP connect timeouts from the healthchecker to 3 warmers while they were rebalancing.
Maya_support: were any recent affinity/weight changes deployed yesterday? we had a customer migration rollout last week.
tom_sre: deploy history: affinity weights rollout yesterday 22:10 UTC for tier-standard. That increases preference for remote-region failover to us-east1 slightly.
rachel_network: combining the transient probe failures + the new weight change explains the decision — the router picked us-east1 instead of failing over to eu-north-1.
Acme_SRE: why not eu-north-1? that's in region proximity list for our org.
tom_sre: router uses per-org weight overrides first; eu-north-1 has a legacy low weight for org-6677 (looks like a migration artifact). I'm seeing a stale override attached to org-6677.
Maya_support: action plan: 1) apply temporary routing override to force eu-west-1 for org-6677, 2) revert yesterday's affinity weight tweak, 3) open infra ticket for autoscaler drain timing, 4) follow up postmortem.
tom_sre: applying override now via admin tool:
```
admin-cli routing override set --org org-6677 --region eu-west-1 --ttl 15m --reason "support: urgent cross-region latency"
```
deploy-bot: override applied by tom_sre at 03:46:10 UTC (id: ov-2026) :white_check_mark:
Maya_support: can you re-run quick curl from customer?
Acme_SRE: retested — now header shows `x-redwood-region: eu-west-1` and p99 back to ~210ms. Thanks, looks fixed for now.
tom_sre: reverting affinity weight change to previous values (rolling back yesterday change)
rachel_network: autoscaler logs show a new drain-time default in the last release shortened from 120s -> 30s; while draining the health checker saw 2x timeouts. Opening INFRA-4102 to track and assign.
autoscaler-bot: ticket INFRA-4102 created, assigned to infra-team, priority P2.
tom_sre: adding a temporary alert: europe-egress-ratio > 4% triggers pager.
Maya_support: notes for postmortem: root cause = transient healthprobe/connect timeouts during a warmer drain + a stale per-org override + recent affinity weight change that nudged router to prefer us-east. Mitigations applied = override + rollback + alerting + autoscaler ticket.
Acme_SRE: appreciate the quick turnaround, leaving this ticket in resolved state on our side.
Maya_support: thanks all — filing short incident note and will include trace + routing logs. Closing thread. :v:
summary: Customer in Frankfurt experienced p99 spikes because router routed to us-east1 after transient eu-west-1 probe failures combined with a stale per-org override and a recent affinity weight change. Temporary override applied and rollout reverted; autoscaler drain bug ticket opened.
